english: Let $z=\cos\dfrac{\pi}{6}+i\sin\dfrac{\pi}{6}$, where $i=\sqrt{-1}$. Then the value of $\displaystyle\sum_{k=0}^{11}\left|1+z^k\right|^8$ is ______.
hindi: माना $z=\cos\dfrac{\pi}{6}+i\sin\dfrac{\pi}{6}$ है, जहाँ $i=\sqrt{-1}$ है। तब $\displaystyle\sum_{k=0}^{11}\left|1+z^k\right|^8$ का मान ______ है।
solution: Inner GP: $=12$ if $z^{j-4}=1$, else $\dfrac{1-z^{12(j-4)}}{1-z^{j-4}}=0$; since $-4\le j-4\le4$, only $j=4$ survives
solution_full: By De Moivre's theorem $z^k=\cos\dfrac{k\pi}{6}+i\sin\dfrac{k\pi}{6}$, so $z^{12}=1$ and $z^m=1$ exactly when $12\mid m$. Also $|z|=1$, so $\bar z=z^{-1}$.
The inner sum is a geometric progression of $12$ terms with ratio $w=z^{j-4}$. If $w=1$ it equals $12$; otherwise it equals $\dfrac{1-w^{12}}{1-w}=0$ because $w^{12}=\left(z^{12}\right)^{j-4}=1$.
$w=1$ needs $12\mid(j-4)$; as $j-4\in\{-4,\dots,4\}$ this happens only for $j=4$.
So the sum is $12\dbinom84=12\cdot70=840$. (Direct check: $\left|1+z^k\right|=2\left|\cos\dfrac{k\pi}{12}\right|$ and $\displaystyle\sum_{k=0}^{11}256\cos^8\frac{k\pi}{12}=840$.)
originality_note: New: a sum of 8th powers of chord lengths over the 12th roots of unity is turned into a binomial double sum in which a geometric progression of roots of unity kills every term but the middle one (way 5: GP summation over roots of unity linked with |w|^2 = w w-bar). Closest known: roots-of-unity filters for sums of binomial coefficients, and products of distances such as the octagon product (2023-P2-Q11). Different because: the quantity is a sum of even powers of moduli, so the conjugate must be written as a power of z before the GP filter applies.
blueprint_concepts: Summation of series involving complex numbers

concept_use.Geometric Progression (GP) & Sum of GP: For each j the inner sum over k is a 12-term GP with ratio z^{j-4}, equal to 12 or 0.
concept_use.Summation of series involving complex nu: |1 + z^k|^8 = z^{-4k}(1 + z^k)^8 uses |w|^2 = w w-bar with z-bar = 1/z, and the binomial expansion turns the sum into GP sums over 12th roots of unity.
